text: RESOLVED: split the type rather than tag it. Interval is absolute, carries a ClockId, and is produced by events from a Recording (rarely hand-constructed). Window is relative -- two Spans from a named anchor -- and carries no clock because it semantically has none. Rationale: the PRD framed this as tag-or-don't, but Interval(ms(0), ms(3000)) as an analysis window was never an absolute interval; conflating the two is its own bug class (eyesim's window is always absolute onsets). Tagging one type would have forced relative windows to invent a clock. Affects k-time, c-events, c-scanpath.
